summary_md: **HASHIMOTO Hiroki ([@reposapo](https://x.com/reposapo/status/2115740580626272766))** summarizes *Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?* ([arXiv 2610.37649](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37649v1)): in the LongChang simulated worlds with altered physics, only GPT-6-Astra discovered the hidden law (16.7%), while other models scored 0%.

referenced_urls.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
